en.text: The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate.

zhSimplified.text: 众人都起来，把耶稣解到彼拉多面前，

zhTraditional.text: 眾人都起來，把耶穌解到彼拉多面前，

en.text: They began to accuse him, saying, “We found this man perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king.”

zhSimplified.text: 就告他说：「我们见这人诱惑国民，禁止纳税给凯撒，并说自己是基督，是王。」

zhTraditional.text: 就告他說：「我們見這人誘惑國民，禁止納稅給凱撒，並說自己是基督，是王。」

en.text: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered him, “Soyou say.”

zhSimplified.text: 彼拉多问耶稣说：「你是犹太人的王吗？」耶稣回答说：「你说的是。」

zhTraditional.text: 彼拉多問耶穌說：「你是猶太人的王嗎？」耶穌回答說：「你說的是。」

en.text: Pilate said to the chief priests and the multitudes, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”

zhSimplified.text: 彼拉多对祭司长和众人说：「我查不出这人有什么罪来。」

zhTraditional.text: 彼拉多對祭司長和眾人說：「我查不出這人有甚麼罪來。」

en.text: But they insisted, saying, “He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee even to this place.”

zhSimplified.text: 但他们越发极力地说：「他煽惑百姓，在犹太遍地传道，从加利利起，直到这里了。」

zhTraditional.text: 但他們越發極力地說：「他煽惑百姓，在猶太遍地傳道，從加利利起，直到這裏了。」

en.text: But when Pilate heard Galilee mentioned, he asked if the man was a Galilean.

zhSimplified.text: 彼拉多一听见，就问：「这人是加利利人吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 彼拉多一聽見，就問：「這人是加利利人嗎？」

en.text: When he found out that he was in Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.

zhSimplified.text: 既晓得耶稣属希律所管，就把他送到希律那里去。那时希律正在耶路撒冷。

zhTraditional.text: 既曉得耶穌屬希律所管，就把他送到希律那裏去。那時希律正在耶路撒冷。

en.text: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad, for he had wanted to see him for a long time, because he had heard many things about him. He hoped to see some miracle done by him.

zhSimplified.text: 希律看见耶稣，就很欢喜；因为听见过他的事，久已想要见他，并且指望看他行一件神迹，

zhTraditional.text: 希律看見耶穌，就很歡喜；因為聽見過他的事，久已想要見他，並且指望看他行一件神蹟，

en.text: He questioned him with many words, but he gave no answers.

zhSimplified.text: 于是问他许多的话，耶稣却一言不答。

zhTraditional.text: 於是問他許多的話，耶穌卻一言不答。

en.text: The chief priests and the scribes stood, vehemently accusing him.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司长和文士都站着，极力地告他。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司長和文士都站着，極力地告他。

en.text: Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.

zhSimplified.text: 希律和他的兵丁就藐视耶稣，戏弄他，给他穿上华丽衣服，把他送回彼拉多那里去。

zhTraditional.text: 希律和他的兵丁就藐視耶穌，戲弄他，給他穿上華麗衣服，把他送回彼拉多那裏去。

en.text: Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day, for before that they were enemies with each other.

zhSimplified.text: 从前希律和彼拉多彼此有仇，在那一天就成了朋友。 （太27·15—26；可15·6—15；约18·39—19·16）

zhTraditional.text: 從前希律和彼拉多彼此有仇，在那一天就成了朋友。 （太27‧15－26；可15‧6－15；約18‧39－19‧16）

en.text: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,

zhSimplified.text: 彼拉多传齐了祭司长和官府并百姓，

zhTraditional.text: 彼拉多傳齊了祭司長和官府並百姓，

en.text: and said to them, “You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people, and behold, having examined him before you, I found no basis for a charge against this man concerning those things of which you accuse him.

zhSimplified.text: 就对他们说：「你们解这人到我这里，说他是诱惑百姓的。看哪，我也曾将你们告他的事，在你们面前审问他，并没有查出他什么罪来；

zhTraditional.text: 就對他們說：「你們解這人到我這裏，說他是誘惑百姓的。看哪，我也曾將你們告他的事，在你們面前審問他，並沒有查出他甚麼罪來；

en.text: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.

zhSimplified.text: 就是希律也是如此，所以把他送回来。可见他没有做什么该死的事。

zhTraditional.text: 就是希律也是如此，所以把他送回來。可見他沒有做甚麼該死的事。

en.text: I will therefore chastise him and release him.”

zhSimplified.text: 故此，我要责打他，把他释放了。」

footnotes.text: - 23:16 有古卷加：\+fv 17\+fv* 每逢这节期，巡抚必须释放一个囚犯给他们。

zhTraditional.text: 故此，我要責打他，把他釋放了。」

footnotes.text: - 23:16 有古卷加： 17 * 每逢這節期，巡撫必須釋放一個囚犯給他們。

en.text: Now he had to release one prisoner to them at the feast.
But they all cried out together, saying, “Away with this man! Release to us Barabbas!”—

zhSimplified.text: 众人却一齐喊着说：「除掉这个人！释放巴拉巴给我们！」

zhTraditional.text: 眾人卻一齊喊着說：「除掉這個人！釋放巴拉巴給我們！」

en.text: one who was thrown into prison for a certain revolt in the city, and for murder.

zhSimplified.text: 这巴拉巴是因在城里作乱杀人，下在监里的。

zhTraditional.text: 這巴拉巴是因在城裏作亂殺人，下在監裏的。

en.text: Then Pilate spoke to them again, wanting to release Jesus,

zhSimplified.text: 彼拉多愿意释放耶稣，就又劝解他们。

zhTraditional.text: 彼拉多願意釋放耶穌，就又勸解他們。

en.text: but they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify him!”

zhSimplified.text: 无奈他们喊着说：「钉他十字架！钉他十字架！」

zhTraditional.text: 無奈他們喊着說：「釘他十字架！釘他十字架！」

en.text: He said to them the third time, “Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him.”

zhSimplified.text: 彼拉多第三次对他们说：「为什么呢？这人做了什么恶事呢？我并没有查出他什么该死的罪来。所以，我要责打他，把他释放了。」

zhTraditional.text: 彼拉多第三次對他們說：「為甚麼呢？這人做了甚麼惡事呢？我並沒有查出他甚麼該死的罪來。所以，我要責打他，把他釋放了。」

en.text: But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. Their voices and the voices of the chief priests prevailed.

zhSimplified.text: 他们大声催逼彼拉多，求他把耶稣钉在十字架上。他们的声音就得了胜。

zhTraditional.text: 他們大聲催逼彼拉多，求他把耶穌釘在十字架上。他們的聲音就得了勝。

en.text: Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done.

zhSimplified.text: 彼拉多这才照他们所求的定案，

zhTraditional.text: 彼拉多這才照他們所求的定案，

en.text: He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, for whom they asked, but he delivered Jesus up to their will.

zhSimplified.text: 把他们所求的那作乱杀人、下在监里的释放了，把耶稣交给他们，任凭他们的意思行。 （太27·32—44；可15·21—32；约19·17—27）

zhTraditional.text: 把他們所求的那作亂殺人、下在監裏的釋放了，把耶穌交給他們，任憑他們的意思行。 （太27‧32－44；可15‧21－32；約19‧17－27）

en.text: When they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid the cross on him to carry it after Jesus.

zhSimplified.text: 带耶稣去的时候，有一个古利奈人西门，从乡下来；他们就抓住他，把十字架搁在他身上，叫他背着跟随耶稣。

zhTraditional.text: 帶耶穌去的時候，有一個古利奈人西門，從鄉下來；他們就抓住他，把十字架擱在他身上，叫他背着跟隨耶穌。

en.text: A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.

zhSimplified.text: 有许多百姓跟随耶稣，内中有好些妇女；妇女们为他号咷痛哭。

zhTraditional.text: 有許多百姓跟隨耶穌，內中有好些婦女；婦女們為他號咷痛哭。

en.text: But Jesus, turning to them, said, “Daughtersof Jerusalem, don’t weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣转身对她们说：「耶路撒冷的女子，不要为我哭，当为自己和自己的儿女哭。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌轉身對她們說：「耶路撒冷的女子，不要為我哭，當為自己和自己的兒女哭。

en.text: Forbehold, the days are coming in which they will say, ‘Blessed are the barren, the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.’

zhSimplified.text: 因为日子要到，人必说：『不生育的，和未曾怀胎的，未曾乳养婴孩的，有福了！』

zhTraditional.text: 因為日子要到，人必說：『不生育的，和未曾懷胎的，未曾乳養嬰孩的，有福了！』

en.text: Thenthey will begin to tell the mountains, ‘Fall on us!’ and tell the hills, ‘Cover us.’

zhSimplified.text: 那时，人要向大山说： 倒在我们身上！ 向小山说： 遮盖我们！

zhTraditional.text: 那時，人要向大山說： 倒在我們身上！ 向小山說： 遮蓋我們！

en.text: Forif they do these things in the green tree, what will be done in the dry?”

zhSimplified.text: 「这些事既行在有汁水的树上，那枯干的树将来怎么样呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 「這些事既行在有汁水的樹上，那枯乾的樹將來怎麼樣呢？」

en.text: There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.

zhSimplified.text: 又有两个犯人，和耶稣一同带来处死。

zhTraditional.text: 又有兩個犯人，和耶穌一同帶來處死。

en.text: When they came to the place that is called “The Skull”, they crucified him there with the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.

zhSimplified.text: 到了一个地方，名叫「髑髅地」，就在那里把耶稣钉在十字架上，又钉了两个犯人：一个在左边，一个在右边。

zhTraditional.text: 到了一個地方，名叫「髑髏地」，就在那裏把耶穌釘在十字架上，又釘了兩個犯人：一個在左邊，一個在右邊。

en.text: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they don’ t know what they are doing.” Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.

zhSimplified.text: 当下耶稣说：「父啊！赦免他们；因为他们所做的，他们不晓得。」兵丁就拈阄分他的衣服。

zhTraditional.text: 當下耶穌說：「父啊！赦免他們；因為他們所做的，他們不曉得。」兵丁就拈鬮分他的衣服。

en.text: The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, “He saved others. Let him save himself, if this is the Christ of God, his chosen one!”

zhSimplified.text: 百姓站在那里观看。官府也嗤笑他，说：「他救了别人；他若是基督， 神所拣选的，可以救自己吧！」

zhTraditional.text: 百姓站在那裏觀看。官府也嗤笑他，說：「他救了別人；他若是基督，上帝所揀選的，可以救自己吧！」

en.text: The soldiers also mocked him, coming to him and offering him vinegar,

zhSimplified.text: 兵丁也戏弄他，上前拿醋送给他喝，

zhTraditional.text: 兵丁也戲弄他，上前拿醋送給他喝，

en.text: and saying, “If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!”

zhSimplified.text: 说：「你若是犹太人的王，可以救自己吧！」

zhTraditional.text: 說：「你若是猶太人的王，可以救自己吧！」

en.text: An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: “THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

zhSimplified.text: 在耶稣以上有一个牌子写着：「这是犹太人的王。」

footnotes.text: - 23:38 有古卷加：用希腊、罗马、希伯来的文字

zhTraditional.text: 在耶穌以上有一個牌子寫着：「這是猶太人的王。」

footnotes.text: - 23:38 有古卷加：用希臘、羅馬、希伯來的文字

en.text: One of the criminals who was hanged insulted him, saying, “If you are the Christ, save yourself and us!”

zhSimplified.text: 那同钉的两个犯人有一个讥笑他，说：「你不是基督吗？可以救自己和我们吧！」

zhTraditional.text: 那同釘的兩個犯人有一個譏笑他，說：「你不是基督嗎？可以救自己和我們吧！」

en.text: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, “Don’t you even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?

zhSimplified.text: 那一个就应声责备他，说：「你既是一样受刑的，还不怕 神吗？

zhTraditional.text: 那一個就應聲責備他，說：「你既是一樣受刑的，還不怕上帝嗎？

en.text: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward for our deeds, but this man has done nothing wrong.”

zhSimplified.text: 我们是应该的，因我们所受的与我们所做的相称，但这个人没有做过一件不好的事。」

zhTraditional.text: 我們是應該的，因我們所受的與我們所做的相稱，但這個人沒有做過一件不好的事。」

en.text: He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”

zhSimplified.text: 就说：「耶稣啊，你得国降临的时候，求你记念我！」

zhTraditional.text: 就說：「耶穌啊，你得國降臨的時候，求你記念我！」

en.text: Jesus said to him, “Assuredly Itell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣对他说：「我实在告诉你，今日你要同我在乐园里了。」 （太27·45—56；可15·33—41；约19·28—30）

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌對他說：「我實在告訴你，今日你要同我在樂園裏了。」 （太27‧45－56；可15‧33－41；約19‧28－30）

en.text: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.

footnotes.text: 23:44 Time was counted from sunrise, so the sixth hour was about noon.

zhSimplified.text: 那时约有午正，遍地都黑暗了，直到申初，

zhTraditional.text: 那時約有午正，遍地都黑暗了，直到申初，

en.text: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.

zhSimplified.text: 日头变黑了；殿里的幔子从当中裂为两半。

zhTraditional.text: 日頭變黑了；殿裏的幔子從當中裂為兩半。

en.text: Jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, “Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!”Having said this, he breathed his last.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣大声喊着说：「父啊！我将我的灵魂交在你手里。」说了这话，气就断了。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌大聲喊着說：「父啊！我將我的靈魂交在你手裏。」說了這話，氣就斷了。

en.text: When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, “Certainly this was a righteous man.”

zhSimplified.text: 百夫长看见所成的事，就归荣耀与 神，说：「这真是个义人！」

zhTraditional.text: 百夫長看見所成的事，就歸榮耀與上帝，說：「這真是個義人！」

en.text: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their chests.

zhSimplified.text: 聚集观看的众人见了这所成的事都捶着胸回去了。

zhTraditional.text: 聚集觀看的眾人見了這所成的事都捶着胸回去了。

en.text: All his acquaintances and the women who followed with him from Galilee stood at a distance, watching these things.

zhSimplified.text: 还有一切与耶稣熟识的人，和从加利利跟着他来的妇女们，都远远地站着看这些事。 （太27·57—61；可15·42—47；约19·38—42）

zhTraditional.text: 還有一切與耶穌熟識的人，和從加利利跟着他來的婦女們，都遠遠地站着看這些事。 （太27‧57－61；可15‧42－47；約19‧38－42）

en.text: Behold, there was a man named Joseph, who was a member of the council, a good and righteous man

zhSimplified.text: 有一个人名叫约瑟，是个议士，为人善良公义；

zhTraditional.text: 有一個人名叫約瑟，是個議士，為人善良公義；

en.text: (he had not consented to their counsel and deed), from Arimathaea, a city of the Jews, who was also waiting for God’s Kingdom.

zhSimplified.text: 众人所谋所为，他并没有附从。他本是犹太、亚利马太城里素常盼望 神国的人。

zhTraditional.text: 眾人所謀所為，他並沒有附從。他本是猶太、亞利馬太城裏素常盼望上帝國的人。

en.text: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.

zhSimplified.text: 这人去见彼拉多，求耶稣的身体，

zhTraditional.text: 這人去見彼拉多，求耶穌的身體，

en.text: He took it down and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb that was cut in stone, where no one had ever been laid.

zhSimplified.text: 就取下来，用细麻布裹好，安放在石头凿成的坟墓里；那里头从来没有葬过人。

zhTraditional.text: 就取下來，用細麻布裹好，安放在石頭鑿成的墳墓裏；那裏頭從來沒有葬過人。

en.text: It was the day of the Preparation, and the Sabbath was drawing near.

zhSimplified.text: 那日是预备日，安息日也快到了。

zhTraditional.text: 那日是預備日，安息日也快到了。

en.text: The women who had come with him out of Galilee followed after, and saw the tomb and how his body was laid.

zhSimplified.text: 那些从加利利和耶稣同来的妇女跟在后面，看见了坟墓和他的身体怎样安放。

zhTraditional.text: 那些從加利利和耶穌同來的婦女跟在後面，看見了墳墓和他的身體怎樣安放。

en.text: They returned and prepared spices and ointments. On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.

zhSimplified.text: 她们就回去，预备了香料香膏。她们在安息日，便遵着诫命安息了。

zhTraditional.text: 她們就回去，預備了香料香膏。她們在安息日，便遵着誡命安息了。
